05778 `Owphay {o-fah'-ee}

源自 05775; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Ephai 1; 1

以斐 = "幽暗的"
1) 一位尼陀法人, 他的眾子是猶大人被擄去巴比倫後所留下的軍隊的軍長 ( #耶40:8| )
record.edic_text:
05778 `Owphay {o-fah'-ee}

from 05775;; n pr m

AV - Ephai 1; 1

Ephai = "gloomy"
1) a Netophathite, whose sons were among the captains of the forces
   left in Judah after the deportation to Babylon
